subject.title: build(deps): bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 4 updates

question: Should this repository accept the `actions/setup-node` v7 major update for its release and publish workflows after reviewing their runner and publish-path compatibility?
rationale: The patch has no discrete source-level defect, but accepting changed third-party workflow runtime behavior on release and scheduled automation is a maintainer operational decision.

options.title: Approve the workflow update
options.body: Accept the upstream action versions after confirming the repository's GitHub-hosted or self-hosted runners and npm publish workflow support the new runtime.

options.title: Hold at current pins
options.body: Keep the existing action pins until a release-workflow owner can validate the major update in the intended runner environment.
